extracted.intended_audience: employers, workplace safety professionals, OSHA compliance officers, legal practitioners, and regulators subject to or enforcing OSHA standards
extracted.subtask_description: A table-of-contents listing of the Occupational Safety and Health Administration's (OSHA) general industry standards codified at 29 CFR Part 1910, with section and subpart headings specifying regulatory topics and requirements employers must follow. Useful as an index of substantive regulatory standards for workplace safety, hazardous substances, equipment, emergency planning, and related compliance obligations.
